D.concept: A compact magic-medieval street with a central fountain plaza on the south side and staggered buildings on both banks of an east-west walkable lane. Two-storey timber-framed shops with varied gabled roofs and hanging signs face the road, while cozy residences with warm windows and small porches sit opposite. The plaza anchors the lane with a fountain, lamp posts, benches and leafy trees, all within a 64x64 metre green.
D.title: Littlebrook Charm Lane

home_hearthglow.concept: Cozy two-storey residence on the south side of Littlebrook Charm Lane. Ground floor holds the hearth and a compact kitchen facing the lane entrance; upper floor gives bed and store. Plaster walls with dark corner posts and framed glazed windows, a sheltered wooden porch with columns, and a warm wood gable roof. Detail follows the local legacy-detail-042.1 policy; plaza benches, lamps and trees around the fixed fountain follow the same documented placement rules.

home_moonbell.concept: South-facing residence on Littlebrook Charm Lane: warm plaster façade with dark corner posts, plinth and framed glazed windows, gabled slate-like roof, timber porch with columns and a straight stair. Hearth/kitchen on the ground floor, bed/store above.

plaza_fountain_court.concept: Magic-medieval fountain court on the north side of Littlebrook Charm Lane: a fixed central fountain ringed by local-policy benches, lamps and leafy trees. Buildings flanking the lane follow the legacy-detail-042.1 builder—two rooms per floor, timber floors, framed glazed windows, dark corner posts, plinths, porches with columns, straight stairs; shops are two-storey with stall/counter below and bed/store or kitchen above, residences one or two storeys with hearth/kitchen/bed/store uses. Varied gable/spire stepped roofs in slate-like dark roofing plus warm wood, stone and plaster facades; storey height 3.4–4m, roof 1–2.5m. No textures, animation, arches or unregistered assets; no engine import or traversal claimed.

shop_gildedowl.concept: Two-storey lane-front shop on the fixed north side of the east-west lane, entry facing south to the street. Ground floor holds a market stall and counter opening to the lane; upper floor provides a bed and store reached by the builder's straight stair. Plastered walls with dark timber corner posts and framed glazed windows sit on the plinth, under a stepped gable roof of slate-like dark roofing at 2.2m. The porch columns, doorway, furniture and stair are supplied by the local legacy-detail-042.1 builder using D-derived dimensions and the documented local policy; no coordinates are assigned here.

shop_runeflask.concept: A two-storey timber-framed corner shop fronting the lane, its entrance on the north edge as fixed by the D site. The ground floor holds a market stall and counter under framed glazed windows and dark corner posts, set on a stone plinth with a columned porch. A straight stair climbs to the upper storey, given over to bed and store. Exterior is plaster with a dark slate roof, shaped as a gable silhouette stepped by the local builder. All dimensions, doorway, furniture and porch derive from the documented construction policy; no cuboid coordinates are chosen here.

F.evidence: B passes: 4 buildings (2 residences, 2 two-storey shops) plus 1 furnished plaza with fountain, 4 benches, 4 lamps, 4 trees; 646 parts; 16 source room routes pass. D defines the bounded 64 m green, one east-west lane, and five entry-to-street sites. E declares matching styles and per-site parameters: residences home_hearthglow and home_moonbell (2 storeys, porch, stairs, windows, hearth/kitchen/bed/store); shops shop_runeflask and shop_gildedowl (2 storeys, stall/counter below, bed/store above, straight stairs); plaza_fountain_court with fixed central fountain and policy-ruled benches, lamps and trees. Required variations are covered: roof material wood vs slate, wall material plaster/stone-like, and roof height 2.0-2.2 m.
limitations: Colour-only materials; no textures, decals or full PBR appearance is established.
Roofs are stepped cuboid gable silhouettes, not true sloped or curved roof geometry.
Scope is a small fixed 64 m street with exactly the declared sites; no additional streets or city-wide density are included.
Trees are simple proxy forms, not detailed foliage models.
Source geometry and schema checks do not establish engine load, collision, traversal, lighting or final appearance.

prompt: 在64米见方的平坦草地区域内，建造一个魔法中世纪风格小街区：两栋住宅、两栋两层商铺和一座带喷泉、长椅、灯及树木的小广场。建筑均沿可步行街道布置，入口朝向街道，保留窗框、木构门廊、室内房间和通向商铺二层的楼梯。住宅和商铺的屋顶与材料要有变化。
